patch.value: Pip delivers fair flyers all over Glitterwood. He is Clementine's biggest fan and dreams of being a magician. He ate lunch at the pond and saw Barnaby chewing willow. He saw last year's show go wrong and hates it when anyone laughs at Clementine.
Pip is a little hedgehog. He saw last year's magic show go wrong.

value: Pip is eight years old and the fastest flyer-boy in Glitterwood.
He wants to be a magician like Clementine one day. He can already make a coin vanish, almost.
He can roll into a ball and bounce down grassy hills.
He sails leaf boats on Moonglow Pond every evening.
His flyers say: 'Glitterwood Fair! Tonight at 7! Lanterns, cakes, and magic!'
His favourite lunch is a berry sandwich.
